Wonderful staff and bartenders, not more
Jan 2020
We came here for a drink at the beginning of our night out in Saigon as it was so close to our hotel and it was recommended as a nice speakeasy bar...
Well.. The place was basically empty around 10pm, there were a few people by the time we left at about 11pm.. 
The drinks we got were actually really nice, we sat by the bar so we got into a nice chat with the guys behind the bar. They were very friendly, eager to please us with different cocktails they made up there on the spot.
Otherwise the place is quite shabby, dark and overpriced really, if you don't hit the happy hour time... you are allowed to smoke inside, so once that started, we left.
The staff is nice, drinks are good, but its not the place I would spend a night out.

Loud, Smokey, and expensive
Sep 2019 • Friends
Not sure how this place can be called a lounge when you’re going to get deaf from the music. It is so loud you have to yell at your friends to make any conversation. While the cocktail I ordered was very good, it was pretty expensive (250k). You should go here if you want to spend a lot of money on drinks and shisha and not be able to converse whatsoever with anyone you go with.

I have been told that this place is awesome on weekdays though as there isn’t as much noise- when it actually is a real lounge.

Complete Ripoff, Empty and Scammers
Jul 2019 • Friends
Went there with a friend as I was visiting Vietnam. Ordered a couple drinks and a shisha. They didnt give us a menu for the shisha and just asked us what flavor we wanted. We ordered the flavor and they brought the shisha after 30 minutes.

After we were done we asked for the check and they charged us $75 for one shisha!! There were definitely cheaper shishas but they didnt even ask and gave us the most expensive one.

When we asked them they said that is the one we ordered which is completely not true.

Horrible place and wouldn't recommend at all. Stay away
